title: Skales: This AI App Has a Lizard Mascot
description:
A developer spent two hours installing Docker to run an AI agent — then realized his wife and six-year-old could never do this. So he rebuilt the whole thing. Skales is a native desktop app — download the exe or dmg, double-click, done. It uses almost zero RAM and gives you a literal lizard desktop mascot. It autonomously handles your emails, manages your calendar, and even browses the web.

https://github.com/skalesapp/skales

#github #opensource
